item.note: This is curious: it seems that at f.318, text from the ending of the previous work and the beginning of this work has slipped into the text. This concerns f.318a1, all text after zhi ba la gnas pa until f.318b1, all text before gnyis su med par. The text in between is to be deleted, and it is difficult to explain how it ended up here. However, this mistake is already found in the earlier sutra collection, Lg15.12, but not in the oldest collection, Lg75.12.
